answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements were available, and they are the largest changes seen in the document. Top-1 agreement is 0.852 (system-prompted range 0.861-0.908, fine-tuned 0.900-0.938). Sequence agreement is 0.312 (system-prompted 0.31-0.48). KL is 0.395 (system-prompted 0.197-0.339, fine-tuned up to 0.205). TV is 0.152 (system-prompted 0.108-0.144, fine-tuned 0.076-0.099). Token-DiFR gap is 0.691 (system-prompted 0.28-0.52). Raw-score shift ÷ TV is 3.3, at the bottom of the system-prompted range 3.3-3.9. It is also within the fine-tuned range 3.1-10.8, so that value does not separate the two. Every value is slightly beyond the system-prompted range in the direction of a bigger change, which is consistent with a single draw of prompts and with a stronger hidden instruction. Fine-tuned is ruled out because KL, TV and the DiFR gap are far above its ranges. Quantized and base are ruled out because the deviations are much too large.
